Name: CP Tobacco Crop
Author: yourdorkbrains
Description:
Adds a green tobacco plant in game and 3 recipes to be made.

This crop grows in spring, summer, and fall (I wanted a crop that grows most seasons, you can change it in content,json to fit your needs).
It takes 11 days to grow and regrows every 4 days with a small chance of multiple crops per harvest. 

You can put in the dehydrator, or the oil makerl. There also is a craft recipe to make a box of cigars once you reach a certain farming level.

You can buy seeds for 180 gold from Pierre.

Does not conflict with any other tobacco crop mod. :)
